changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_meta ( page_id bigint PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES page(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, space_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES space(id), doc_type varchar(20) NOT NULL, doc_id varchar(100), status varchar(30), title varchar(300) NOT NULL, owner varchar(100), sprint varchar(50), feature varchar(50), priority varchar(10), tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', depends text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', related text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', meta jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', valid boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, errors jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_meta_query ON page_meta (space_id, doc_type, status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_meta_docid ON page_meta (space_id, doc_id) WHERE doc_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_meta_tags ON page_meta USING gin (tags)
